<thought>We will generate a minimal valid TiO₂ CIF (rutile) that starts with “data_TiO2”. This CIF includes the space group, cell parameters, and atomic positions. We'll pass it to the enumerate_slabs_text tool (default Miller index (1,1,1), min_slab_size 12 Å, min_vacuum_size 5 Å). The tool will return a JSON dictionary of all possible slab terminations. We'll then write that JSON to a file named slabs.json and finally provide the path to that file.</thought>
